claim_text: Carbon capture is cost-effective for industrial decarbonisation.

evidence_spans.span_text: CCS is technically viable for some industries at scale.

claim_text: Renewables are reliable enough for baseload power.

evidence_spans.span_text: Solar and wind with storage can provide baseload in some grids.

claim_text: Soil carbon sequestration offsets are credible.

evidence_spans.span_text: Soil carbon methodologies are under development and certification.

claim_text: Precision fermentation will be cost-competitive with animal protein by 2030.

evidence_spans.span_text: Costs have fallen; some analysts project parity, others are sceptical.

claim_text: Green bonds direct capital to genuine environmental projects.

evidence_spans.span_text: Green bond standards vary; some certified bonds fund questionable projects.

claim_text: Deep ocean currents will slow significantly by 2050.

evidence_spans.span_text: Models disagree on the pace of ocean circulation changes.

claim_text: EV battery recycling solves the critical mineral scarcity problem.

evidence_spans.span_text: Battery recycling is growing but capacity is insufficient for projected demand.

claim_text: Agroforestry increases both biodiversity and yields.

evidence_spans.span_text: Evidence on yield effects of agroforestry is mixed by region and crop.

claim_text: Hydrogen leakage from pipelines is negligible.

evidence_spans.span_text: Studies show variable leakage rates; some find measurable atmospheric impact.

claim_text: Carbon-neutral shipping is achievable before 2050.

evidence_spans.span_text: IMO targets aim for 50% reduction by 2050; full neutrality is debated.

claim_text: Methane removal from the atmosphere is technically feasible.

evidence_spans.span_text: Some atmospheric methane removal approaches are under research but unproven at scale.

claim_text: Sustainable aviation fuel will dominate by 2040.

evidence_spans.span_text: SAF growth is fast but feedstock and cost constraints are debated.

claim_text: Energy storage can fully address renewable intermittency.

evidence_spans.span_text: Storage addresses short-term intermittency; seasonal storage remains costly.

claim_text: Blue hydrogen is a viable bridge fuel in a net-zero transition.

evidence_spans.span_text: CCS efficiency for blue hydrogen production is disputed.

claim_text: Climate models overestimate warming in tropical regions.

evidence_spans.span_text: Some models show higher tropical sensitivity; bias estimates vary.

claim_text: Nature-based solutions can deliver 30% of mitigation needed by 2030.

evidence_spans.span_text: Some analyses support 30%; others note permanence and monitoring challenges.

claim_text: Nuclear new builds will be cheaper than solar by 2035.

evidence_spans.span_text: Industry claims vs independent cost trajectories disagree.

claim_text: Water scarcity will affect half the world by 2030.

evidence_spans.span_text: Projections on water stress vary significantly by methodology.

claim_text: Urban agriculture can meaningfully reduce food system emissions.

evidence_spans.span_text: Urban ag reduces transport; land use and energy use can offset gains.

claim_text: Long-haul aviation can be fully decarbonised with current technology.

evidence_spans.span_text: Electric planes viable only for short haul; SAF and hydrogen for long haul are not ready.
